problem_summary: Customers consistently report severe delivery delays, with orders taking an excessively long time to arrive despite the product itself being satisfactory.

claims.text: Delivery times are excessively long, with some orders taking over a month to arrive or arriving well after the intended time of use.
Customers express that while the product quality is good or satisfactory, the delivery speed is extremely slow.
Repeat buyers report experiencing slow and delayed shipping on their reorders.

recommendation: Audit the order fulfillment and dispatch timeline, and switch to or hold carrier partners accountable to faster, more reliable shipping schedules.

problem_summary: Products are frequently arriving dented, crushed, or broken due to weak and inadequate protective packaging, such as shipping items in simple vinyl wrapping without proper boxes or cushioning.

claims.text: Products and packages frequently arrive dented or crushed during transit due to weak packaging.
Products arrive cracked, broken, or burst and leaking because packaging does not adequately protect them.
Customers note that items are shipped in flimsy vinyl wrapping or poorly secured packaging rather than protective boxes.

recommendation: Replace minimal vinyl wrapping with sturdy shipping boxes and include shock-absorbing cushioning (such as bubble wrap) to prevent items from being crushed or breaking during delivery.

abstain_reason: The reviews represent a collection of completely disparate products (e.g., food, bags, felt fabric, electronics, socks/clothing) with vague and inconsistent complaints. Feedback on delivery is contradictory (some report very fast delivery while others report slow delivery), and complaints of inconvenience ('불편해요') point to unrelated product issues without a single, concrete, fixable problem.
